moves.name: Bullet Punch
moves.description:
Steel (Physical)
Base Power: 40
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 1
No additional effect.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.description:
Bug (Physical)
Base Power: 60
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects even if the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
Raises the user's Attack by 2 stages.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description:
Fighting (Physical)
Base Power: 120
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Dual Wingbeat
moves.description:
Flying (Physical)
Base Power: 40
Accuracy: 90
Priority: 0
Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.description:
Dark (Physical)
Base Power: 65
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
This move's power is multiplied by 1.5 if the target is holding an item, and the target loses its held item if the user has not fainted. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. This move does not increase in power or remove the target's item if it is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask held by a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively, or if the user is one of those species and the target is holding the respective item. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description:
Bug (Physical)
Base Power: 70
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

moves.name: Assurance
moves.description:
Dark (Physical)
Base Power: 60
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Power doubles if the target has already taken damage this turn, other than direct damage from Belly Drum, confusion, Curse, or Pain Split.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description:
Fighting (Physical)
Base Power: 75
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Metal Coat
items.description: Holder's Steel-type attacks have 1.2x power. Evolves Onix into Steelix and Scyther into Scizor when traded.

items.name: Expert Belt
items.description: Holder's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.2x damage.

items.name: Occa Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Fire-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Choice Scarf
items.description: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

items.name: White Herb
items.description: Restores all lowered stat stages to 0 when one is less than 0. Single use.

abilities.name: Technician
abilities.description: This Pokemon's moves of 60 power or less have their power multiplied by 1.5, including Struggle. This effect comes after a move's effect changes its own power.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.description: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Bug-type attack.

abilities.name: Light Metal
abilities.description: This Pokemon's weight is halved, rounded down to a tenth of a kilogram. This effect is calculated after the effect of Autotomize, and before the effect of Float Stone. A Pokemon's weight will not drop below 0.1 kg.
